title: 第321章 陷阱天机遁走第320章 元婴后期
content_zh:
"哈哈哈！天助我也！"
“老夫早已算到此处有机缘，没想到，除了大秦玉玺之外，还有这意外之喜！”
炼虚境虽强，却终究是此方天地灵气淬炼而成。
若能将混沌之气纳入体内，淬炼神魂、重塑道基，他便能真正踏足那传说中的境界，天地再无法束缚他的脚步。
天机老人大袖一卷，周身灵光化作一道漩涡，将那缕混沌之气牢牢锁住，牵引向自身。
徐长生从祭坛残骸中挣扎着站起，眼中闪过一丝异色。
他感知到，那缕混沌之气翻涌的深处，还藏着一丝寂灭法则之力。
若不是他身具混沌之气，又对寂灭之力有所领悟，恐怕根本就察觉不到。
“不愧是墨家巨子，这等手段，真是令人防不胜防！”徐长生心中暗道。
徐长生脸色突然一变，给正要上前的胡娇娇传音。
"快退！"
胡娇娇虽然不解，却很信任徐长生，立刻向后暴退。
天机老人看到徐长生和胡娇娇后退，只当他们想跑，根本就不在意。
他心心念念的，只有这一缕混沌之气。
“嗤嗤”
受到天机老人气机牵引，祭坛下方的混沌之气，如同乳燕归巢，尽数来到天机老人身前，天机老人双眼冒光，正欲将之纳入体内。
"轰"
异变突生！
那缕混沌之气骤然炸开。
一股裹挟着寂灭之力的伟力，直冲天机老人面门。

天机老人瞳孔骤缩，那抹贪婪的笑容，在脸上彻底凝固。
“什么鬼东西！？”
他气急败坏，双手猛然结印，灵光在身前交织成一道厚重的光幕。
"咔嚓"
光幕表面浮现出细密的裂纹，随后，轰然碎裂。
寂灭之力润物细无声，轻飘飘落在天机老人的胸膛之上。
然而，天机老人却如遭雷击，"噗"的张口喷出一口暗金色的血液。
体内生机，瞬间被掠夺了大半！
本就花白的头发，枯草般掉落了个干净。
身上的血肉，更是被掠夺一空，仅剩下一层皮包骨。
"好一个墨家巨子！"
天机老人咬牙切齿，眼中浮现出一丝惊怒交加的神色，"竟在混沌灵气里，埋了这般手段！"
"死了还要摆老夫一道！"
他本以为那缕混沌之气是天地馈赠，却万万没想到，那是墨家巨子留下的最后一道陷阱。
以混沌之气为饵，将一道足以重创炼虚境修士的法则之力封印其中，只待有人贪心炼化便引爆。
墨家巨子镇守帝陵数千年，留的后手又何止四象锁天阵一重？
为了守护大秦玉玺，他真是煞费苦心了。
徐长生看得真切，眼中闪过一抹精光。
"他现在被法则之力压制，实力大打折扣！"
"一起上！"

闻言，胡娇娇身形如一道白色闪电骤然暴起，双掌裹挟化神境全力一击，直取天机老人后心。
与此同时，徐影、徐福、徐寿三具傀儡尸也同时暴起，从三个方向扑向天机老人。
四条身影如同四道利箭，将天机老人的退路尽数封锁。
"蝼蚁再多，也不过是蝼蚁！"
天机老人冷哼一声，大袖一挥，五色灵光如同潮水般涌出。
content_en:
"Hahaha! God help me!"
"I had already calculated that there would be a chance here, but I didn't expect that besides the Great Qin Jade Seal, there would be such an unexpected surprise!"
Although the Void Refining Realm is strong, it is ultimately made by tempering the spiritual energy of this world.
If he could incorporate the energy of chaos into his body, refine his soul, and reshape his Dao foundation, he would be able to truly step into the legendary realm, and heaven and earth would no longer be able to constrain his steps.
Old Man Tianji rolled up his sleeves, and the spiritual light around his body turned into a whirlpool, firmly locking the chaotic energy and pulling it towards himself.
Xu Changsheng struggled to stand up from the remains of the altar, a strange color flashing in his eyes.
He sensed that deep within the surging air of chaos, there was still a hint of the power of the Law of Annihilation.
If he hadn't possessed the energy of chaos and understood the power of annihilation, he might not have noticed it at all.
"As expected of a giant from the Mohist family, these methods are really hard to guard against!" Xu Changsheng thought to himself.
Xu Changsheng's expression suddenly changed and he sent a message to Hu Jiaojiao who was about to step forward.
"Quickly retreat!"
Although Hu Jiaojiao was puzzled, she trusted Xu Changsheng and immediately retreated.
When Old Man Tianji saw Xu Changsheng and Hu Jiaojiao retreating, he just thought they wanted to run away and didn't care at all.
All he was thinking about was this wisp of chaos.
"Chichi"
Drawn by Old Man Tianji's energy, the chaotic energy under the altar, like swallows returning to their nests, all came to Old Man Tianji. Old Man Tianji's eyes were shining, and he was about to take it into his body.
"Boom"
A sudden change occurred!
The ray of chaotic energy suddenly exploded.
A powerful force carrying the power of annihilation rushed straight to the face of Old Man Tianji.
Old Man Tianji's pupils shrank suddenly, and that greedy smile completely froze on his face.
"What the hell!?"
He was so angry that he suddenly formed seals with his hands, and the spiritual light intertwined into a thick curtain of light in front of him.
"click"
Fine cracks appeared on the surface of the light curtain, and then it shattered.
The power of annihilation moistened things silently, falling lightly on the chest of old man Tianji.
However, Old Man Tianji felt as if he was struck by lightning, and he opened his mouth and spat out a mouthful of dark golden blood.
Most of the vitality in the body was robbed in an instant!
The already gray hair fell out like withered grass.
All the flesh and blood on his body had been plundered, leaving only a layer of skin and bones.
"What a Mohist giant!"
Old Man Tianji gritted his teeth, and a look of shock and anger appeared in his eyes, "Such a method is actually buried in the chaotic aura!"
"Even if you die, you still have to show off to me!"
He originally thought that the chaotic energy was a gift from heaven and earth, but he never expected that it was the last trap left by the Mohist giant.
Using the energy of chaos as bait, a force of law capable of severely damaging a monk in the Void Refining Realm is sealed in it, waiting for someone to be greedy to refine it before detonating it.
The Mohist giant has guarded the imperial mausoleum for thousands of years, but he has left more than one level of the Four Symbols Locking Heaven Formation?
In order to protect the Great Qin Jade Seal, he really took great pains.
Xu Changsheng saw it clearly, and a glint flashed in his eyes.
"He is now suppressed by the power of law, and his strength is greatly reduced!"
"Come together!"
Hearing this, Hu Jiaojiao's figure suddenly rose up like a white lightning, and she used her palms to attack the God Transformation Realm with all her strength, directly striking Old Man Tianji's heart.
At the same time, the three puppet corpses of Xu Ying, Xu Fu, and Xu Shou also burst out at the same time, rushing towards Old Man Tianji from three directions.
The four figures were like four sharp arrows, blocking all the retreat routes for Old Man Tianji.
"No matter how many ants there are, they are still just ants!"
Old Man Tianji snorted coldly, waved his sleeves, and five-colored auras poured out like a tide.
